summary: Address Greptile security and correctness findings in the shipped Cookidoo package.
reason: The review identified MCP callers controlling the Shopper executable, recipe HTML being returned without its JSON-LD recipe data, concurrent profile writes losing updates, and a patch record stored outside the Cookidoo package.
validated_outcome: The implementation and regression tests are in the shipped Cookidoo module. Against package code at 9072bca039c782e48bc372e173486a739c9b1257, Go 1.26.9 go test ./..., go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., and go build ./... passed locally with a temporary modfile replacing pinned mcp-go v0.57.0 with cached v0.47.0; the pinned-dependency GitHub govulncheck and five package/manifest/supply-chain verification checks passed on the same code commit. Greptile review is pending on the corrected module paths.
